status: pre-registered before any update 201..300 data from the real (GPU) run existed
registered_by: FORGE, from AJ's 'fix everything' instruction relayed by VERA on Nov 10 2026 (UTC-6)
reading_note: FORGE chose this reading of the original wording: the exact-0 segment condition gates BOTH gain clauses. The earlier dual-reading/ambiguous path was removed.

data.benchmark: X64 teacher-forced masked-byte readout, two splits: train (40 rows) and held-out (40 unseen rows)

arithmetic.token_acc_pct: tokens_correct / tokens * 100, evaluated only through exact integer cross-multiplication; no float, no rounding

STUCK.iff: (X64 train segments_exact(300) == 0 AND X64 held-out segments_exact(300) == 0) AND (heldout_token_acc(300) - heldout_token_acc(200) < 10.0 pp OR train_token_acc(300) - train_token_acc(250) < 3.0 pp)
train_gain_pair: update 250 train tokens_correct/1920 (measured in the same run)

SLOW_LEARNER_EVIDENCE.iff: at ANY of 225/250/275/300: X64 held-out segments_exact > 0 AND Y72 segments_exact at that same checkpoint >= 80.0% (>= 160/200)

verdict: STUCK if the STUCK condition holds, otherwise INCONCLUSIVE. SLOW_LEARNER_EVIDENCE and RETENTION_FAILURE are separate flags reported alongside the verdict.
training: always stops at update 300 regardless of verdict; no automatic follow-up, no threshold relaxation
separate: the original scientific joint gates remain separate and unchanged
implementation: tools/experiment_packaging/stop_rule.py (pinned to this file by tests/test_stop_rule.py)
